purpose: Fit monitor planes from binocular fixation rays and optionally recover metric scale from consensus EDID dimensions.

activities.label: reconstruct binocular fixation points and fit EDID-scaled monitor planes

queries.question: Can VIZZ infer a stable monitor plane from binocular gaze rays and use EDID only as an optional metric scale anchor?

assumptions: A future provider can express both eye rays in a shared head/world frame.
Presented target coordinates are generated by VIZZ and are not inferred from the mouse.
EDID dimensions are a scale anchor only; pose must be estimated from gaze/head constraints or another source.
kill_tests: Insufficient or collinear target geometry returns UNKNOWN.
Relative-only fits cannot be reported as metres.
Conflicting EDID aspect scales return UNKNOWN.
No camera, network, screen mutation or mouse ground truth is used.
unknowns: Whether the current webcam can estimate two gaze rays with enough vergence signal.
Whether the existing GPU provider exposes eye centres and directions in one frame.
The real noise and latency under glasses, distance changes and natural head motion.
